  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(primer.data)

x <- shaming |> 
  mutate(
    voter_class = case_when(
      primary_00 + general_00 + primary_02 + general_02 + primary_04 + general_04 <= 2 ~ "Rarely Vote",
      primary_00 + general_00 + primary_02 + general_02 + primary_04 + general_04 <= 4 ~ "Sometimes Vote",
      TRUE ~ "Always Vote"
    ),
    voter_class = factor(voter_class, levels = c("Rarely Vote", "Sometimes Vote", "Always Vote"))
  )
```

```{r}
x |> 
  group_by(treatment, voter_class) |> 
  summarize(mean_turnout = mean(primary_06), .groups = "drop") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = treatment, y = mean_turnout, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ voter_class) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Turnout by Treatment and Voter Class",
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Mean Turnout",
    fill = "Treatment"
  )
```
